title: Not the End of the World
description: This “truly essential” audiobook will transform how you see our biggest environmental problems (Margaret Atwood) - and explains how we can solve them. It’s become common to tell kids that they’re going to die from climate change. We are constantly bombarded by doomsday headlines that tell us the soil won’t be able to support crops, fish will vanish from our oceans, and that we should reconsider having children. Bu...
